headline: The shooting at the Aarau rave was a rampage
lead: A 43-year-old Swiss man from Jura surrendered to police Monday night. The perpetrator fired into a crowd with a Kalashnikov and a pistol. One woman died and six other people were injured.
seo_title: The shooting at the Aarau rave was a rampage
social_title: The shooting at the Aarau rave was a rampage
summary_bullets_en: A 43-year-old Swiss man carried out a shooting spree in Aarau and later turned himself in to police.
The assailant used a Kalashnikov and a pistol, killing one woman and injuring six others.
key_questions_de: Was waren die Motive des Täters beim Amoklauf in Aarau?
Wie reagierte die Polizei auf die Selbstanzeige des Täters?
Welche Sicherheitsmassnahmen werden nach dem Vorfall ergriffen?

original_de.headline: Bei der Schiesserei am Aarauer Rave handelte es sich um einen Amoklauf
